title: CRIS Tender v0.1 Assessment (draft)
description: A draft generic framework for assessing CRIS solutions with a repository function, based on the public European tender of Maastricht University (2026) for a CRIS with repository function, with knock-out, weighted and award criteria. Source tender: https://app.mercell.com/tender/1548230057/Current-Research-Information-System-(CRIS)-with-repository-function
aboutHtml:
CRIS Tender v0.1 (draft) is a generic assessment framework for procuring a Current Research Information System (CRIS) with a repository function. It is based on the public European tender of Maastricht University (UM) and Maastricht University Medical Centre+ (MUMC+) for a CRIS with repository function, published in 2026 on Mercell: Current Research Information System (CRIS) with repository function. The framework draws on the full set of tender documents in the request for tenders (programme of requirements, non-functional requirements, plan of approach, suitability requirements and price schedule). Institution-specific details (source systems, keyword schemes, volumes and dates) have been made generic, so other institutions can reuse it to compare solutions, align their own tenders and discuss shared requirements.

Priorities. Every principle names a priority. Must marks a knock-out requirement in the source tender: an offer that does not meet it is excluded. Should and Could mark scored requirements with a higher (7 points or more) or lower weight. Award criterion marks the qualitative plans and the price, which are scored rather than pass or fail. The priority is also stored as a machine-readable priority and knockOut field on each principle.

Weighting in the source tender. Roughly 30% plan of approach, 20% price, 40% functional requirements and 10% non-functional requirements, with a minimum quality score of 65%. The initial contract term was four years with optional extensions up to ten years, and a separate, yearly renewable term for the repository function to keep the option of moving to a dedicated open access repository.

Scoring. Compliant means fully supported in the standard product or by configuration. Making progress means partly supported, requiring custom development, or on a dated roadmap. Not compliant means not supported. For the plans, the three levels map onto the 0 to 10 marking scale of the source tender. The “To improve” note gives the evidence to ask a supplier for.

This is a concept (v0.1), drafted with AI assistance (Claude) and pending review by SURF and the institutions involved. It is not an official SURF or UKB instrument.

principles.title: Relevant references
principles.text: The supplier can show at least one recent reference (within the last three years) for supplying, implementing and maintaining a CRIS, and one for a repository function, at a research institution of comparable size. Experience of subcontractors only counts if they are deployed on this contract. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: recent, verifiable references for both a CRIS and a repository function at comparable institutions.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: recent, verifiable references for both a CRIS and a repository function at comparable institutions works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: recent, verifiable references for both a CRIS and a repository function at comparable institutions. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Request one reference per competency with a client contact person who may be called to verify it.

principles.title: Financial and economic strength
principles.text: The supplier has no known claims or required investments that put its continuity at risk, its latest audit opinion contains no going-concern paragraph, and it is adequately insured (professional and third-party liability) for the full contract term. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: financial continuity, a clean audit opinion and adequate insurance.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: financial continuity, a clean audit opinion and adequate insurance works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: financial continuity, a clean audit opinion and adequate insurance. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Request the latest audit opinion and proof of insurance from the provisionally selected supplier.

principles.title: Eligibility and exclusion grounds
principles.text: The supplier is registered in the relevant trade or professional register, signatories are authorised to represent it, no exclusion grounds apply (European Single Procurement Document), and applicable EU sanctions do not apply to the supplier or its subcontractors. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: registration, authority to sign, absence of exclusion grounds and sanctions compliance.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: registration, authority to sign, absence of exclusion grounds and sanctions compliance works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: registration, authority to sign, absence of exclusion grounds and sanctions compliance. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Request the ESPD, trade register extract, power of attorney where relevant, and a sanctions statement.

principles.title: Centralised research information platform
principles.text: The solution provides a centralised platform for storing research-related information entities. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: a single platform for all research information entities.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: a single platform for all research information entities works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: a single platform for all research information entities. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for an overview of the entity model and how entities are stored and related.

principles.title: Broad range of content types
principles.text: The solution stores, manages and exchanges high-quality, machine-readable metadata for a broad range of content types, including research outputs (articles, books, chapters, reviews, working papers), datasets, software, activities, prizes and awards, press and media mentions, grant applications, grants, projects and facilities or equipment, each with its own (sub)types and metadata fields. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: all listed content types with their (sub)types and metadata fields.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: all listed content types with their (sub)types and metadata fields works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: all listed content types with their (sub)types and metadata fields. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for the content type catalogue with the metadata fields per (sub)type.

principles.title: Adjustable controlled vocabularies
principles.text: The solution supports adjustable controlled vocabularies for metadata fields, including non-bibliographic ones such as staff type, organisation type, job title and licence type. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: administrator-managed controlled vocabularies for bibliographic and non-bibliographic fields.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: administrator-managed controlled vocabularies for bibliographic and non-bibliographic fields works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: administrator-managed controlled vocabularies for bibliographic and non-bibliographic fields. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of adding and changing a vocabulary value without vendor involvement.

principles.title: Journal filtering on custom classifications
principles.text: The solution supports filtering of journals based on custom (institutional) classifications. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: filtering journals on custom classifications.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: filtering journals on custom classifications works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: filtering journals on custom classifications.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of filtering journals by an institutional classification.

principles.title: Role and organisation based access
principles.text: The solution provides role- and organisation-based access, controlled by system administrators, defining which content may be accessed and which tasks may be executed. The supplier can show which roles exist and which rights belong to each. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable roles with organisation-scoped rights.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable roles with organisation-scoped rights works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable roles with organisation-scoped rights. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a short video showing which roles can be assigned and which rights are attached to each.

principles.title: Validated bulk operations
principles.text: The solution supports bulk import, export and metadata updates (for example XML, JSON or database ingest), with validation mechanisms that guard data quality during these bulk operations. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: bulk import, export and update with validation.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: bulk import, export and update with validation works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: bulk import, export and update with validation. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for documentation of the bulk formats and the validation and error reporting they provide.

principles.title: Flexible and advanced search
principles.text: The solution supports flexible search, filtering and sorting across all core entities, including full-text search, Boolean operators and cross-entity search. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: full-text, Boolean and cross-entity search with filtering and sorting.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: full-text, Boolean and cross-entity search with filtering and sorting works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: full-text, Boolean and cross-entity search with filtering and sorting. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of a Boolean full-text search across several entity types.

principles.title: Configurable record visibility
principles.text: The solution supports configurable visibility levels for records (for example public, internal, restricted). Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable visibility levels per record.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable visibility levels per record works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable visibility levels per record. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask which visibility levels exist and how they propagate to API, portal and exports.

principles.title: Configurable validation workflows
principles.text: The solution supports configurable validation workflows and approval statuses on all entities. The supplier describes how and to what extent workflows can be configured, for example for publications, journals and activities. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable validation workflows and approval statuses on all entity types.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable validation workflows and approval statuses on all entity types works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable validation workflows and approval statuses on all entity types. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a written description (about two pages) of workflow configuration for publications, journals and activities.

principles.title: Multilingual titles
principles.text: The solution supports multilingual metadata for titles. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: titles in more than one language.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: titles in more than one language works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: titles in more than one language.

principles.improvementAction: Ask how translated titles are stored, displayed and exported.

principles.title: Notifications, messaging and comments
principles.text: The solution supports configurable notifications and messaging to users, including sending comments about an entity to its users and editors. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable notifications and comments on entities.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable notifications and comments on entities works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable notifications and comments on entities.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for an overview of notification triggers and how comments reach users and editors.

principles.title: Task overviews for operational users
principles.text: The solution provides configurable task overviews for operational users such as validators and editors. Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable task overviews for operational roles.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable task overviews for operational roles works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable task overviews for operational roles.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of a validator's task overview and how it is configured.

principles.title: Responsible AI-assisted enrichment and discovery
principles.text: The solution supports responsible, transparent AI-assisted metadata enrichment and semantic discovery, with human control over what is accepted. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: AI-assisted enrichment and semantic discovery under human control.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: AI-assisted enrichment and semantic discovery under human control works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: AI-assisted enrichment and semantic discovery under human control.

principles.improvementAction: Ask which models are used, where they run, what data they see and how suggestions are reviewed.

principles.title: Linking related entities
principles.text: The solution supports linking between related scholarly entities such as publications, datasets, software, projects and activities. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: typed relations between all scholarly entities.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: typed relations between all scholarly entities works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: typed relations between all scholarly entities. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for the relation model and a demonstration of linking a dataset and software to a publication and project.

principles.title: Configurable fields, classifications and keyword schemes
principles.text: The solution supports configurable metadata fields, custom classifications and multiple institution-specific keyword schemes (for example institutional, discipline-specific, national-evaluation and open access keywords) alongside controlled vocabularies. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable fields, custom classifications and multiple keyword schemes.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable fields, custom classifications and multiple keyword schemes works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable fields, custom classifications and multiple keyword schemes. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask how many keyword schemes can run side by side and who can maintain them.

principles.title: Duplicate detection and merging
principles.text: The solution detects duplicate records and entities using DOI, ORCID, title matching and person and organisation names and identifiers, and supports merging and resolution workflows for duplicates. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: duplicate detection on identifiers and names, plus merge workflows.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: duplicate detection on identifiers and names, plus merge workflows works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: duplicate detection on identifiers and names, plus merge workflows. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of a duplicate being flagged and merged, including what happens to relations.

principles.title: Export in multiple formats
principles.text: The solution exports records and reports in multiple formats, including PDF, spreadsheet and bibliographic exchange formats. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: export to PDF, spreadsheet and bibliographic exchange formats.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: export to PDF, spreadsheet and bibliographic exchange formats works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: export to PDF, spreadsheet and bibliographic exchange formats. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for the list of supported export formats.

principles.title: Visible workflow, visibility and publication status
principles.text: The solution displays the workflow status, visibility status and publication status of records, and lets authorised users change the workflow status. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: visible and editable record statuses.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: visible and editable record statuses works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: visible and editable record statuses. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a short video of a record in edit mode where the workflow status is changed.

principles.title: Multiple affiliations per output
principles.text: The solution allows multiple affiliations per output, both through persons and directly through organisations, and lets users select, add and remove internal and external affiliations within a record. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: multiple internal and external affiliations per author and per output.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: multiple internal and external affiliations per author and per output works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: multiple internal and external affiliations per author and per output. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a screenshot and short video of affiliation handling within a publication record.

principles.title: Minimum fields per output type
principles.text: Each output type template contains at least type, year or date, title, subtitle, authors, corresponding author and multiple affiliations per author. Output types for publications also contain publication status. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: the minimum field set on every output type.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: the minimum field set on every output type works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: the minimum field set on every output type. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for the field list of each output type template.

principles.title: Audience for national evaluation
principles.text: The solution offers a choice of audience for national evaluation purposes (for example academic, professional, popular). Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: an audience field suitable for national evaluation.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: an audience field suitable for national evaluation works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: an audience field suitable for national evaluation. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask how audience is recorded and reported.

principles.title: National evaluation mappings
principles.text: The solution supports the national categorisations used for research evaluation and output registration (in the Netherlands: the KUOZ definitions and the SEP protocol) for publications and activities. Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: mapping of outputs and activities to national evaluation categories.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: mapping of outputs and activities to national evaluation categories works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: mapping of outputs and activities to national evaluation categories.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for the mapping table and how it is maintained when national definitions change.

principles.title: Journals, series, publishers and events
principles.text: The solution stores and manages publication series, journals, publishers and scholarly events as entities. Priority: Must (knock-out requirement).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: journals, series, publishers and events as managed entities.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: journals, series, publishers and events as managed entities works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: journals, series, publishers and events as managed entities. As a knock-out requirement, this excludes the offer.

principles.improvementAction: Ask how these entities are sourced, deduplicated and maintained.

principles.title: Supervision relationships
principles.text: The solution supports supervision relationships between persons and publications or activities (for example PhD supervision). Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: supervision relationships.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: supervision relationships works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: supervision relationships.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of recording a PhD supervisor on a thesis.

principles.title: Bibliographic notes and editorial comments
principles.text: The solution stores bibliographic notes and editorial comments on records. Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: notes and editorial comments on records.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: notes and editorial comments on records works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: notes and editorial comments on records.

principles.improvementAction: Ask who can see notes and whether they are exported.

principles.title: Predefined licence schemes
principles.text: The solution supports predefined licence schemes (for example Creative Commons) on outputs and files. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: predefined licence schemes.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: predefined licence schemes works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: predefined licence schemes.

principles.improvementAction: Ask which licence schemes are available and whether they are exposed in OAI-PMH and API.

principles.title: Persistent identifier minting
principles.text: The solution supports persistent identifier minting workflows, such as DOI registration integrations. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: PID minting workflows such as DOI registration.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: PID minting workflows such as DOI registration works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: PID minting workflows such as DOI registration.

principles.improvementAction: Ask which PID services are integrated (for example DataCite) and how minting is triggered.

principles.title: Collaborations, author groups and roles
principles.text: The solution supports collaboration and co-authorship structures, adding author collaborations or groups to a record, and assigning specific roles to a person within a record (author, editor, speaker, organiser, attendee). Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: collaborations, author groups and person roles within records.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: collaborations, author groups and person roles within records works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: collaborations, author groups and person roles within records.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of a large-consortium publication with an author group.

principles.title: Metadata completeness and quality checks
principles.text: The solution supports configurable metadata completeness and quality checks. Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: configurable completeness and quality checks.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: configurable completeness and quality checks works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: configurable completeness and quality checks.

principles.improvementAction: Ask which checks exist out of the box and how custom rules are added.

principles.title: Role-based export templates
principles.text: The solution supports role-based, configurable export templates and field selections (which columns are exported, and for whom). Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: role-based export templates and field selection.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: role-based export templates and field selection works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: role-based export templates and field selection.

principles.improvementAction: Ask for a demonstration of creating an export template for a specific role.

principles.title: Saved search filters
principles.text: The solution supports saving and reusing custom search filters. Priority: Should (heavily weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: saving and reusing search filters.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: saving and reusing search filters works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: saving and reusing search filters.

principles.improvementAction: Ask whether saved filters can be shared between users.

principles.title: Document augmentation for uploaded PDFs
principles.text: The solution supports cover page generation or configurable document augmentation workflows for uploaded PDF files. Priority: Could (lightly weighted).

criteria.compliant: Fully supported in the standard product or by configuration, without custom development: cover page generation or PDF augmentation.
criteria.progress: Partly supported: cover page generation or PDF augmentation works only in part, needs custom development or workarounds, or is on a dated roadmap.
criteria.non-compliant: Not supported and not on a dated roadmap: cover page generation or PDF augmentation.

principles.title: Transparent total cost of ownership
principles.text: The supplier completes a price schedule (excluding VAT) covering the initial contract term: annual licence and support fees per module, and one-off costs for implementation, training, migration and transition, and exit, with any other costs itemised. First-year prices are fixed and later indexation follows the contract. Priority: Award criterion (price).

criteria.compliant: All cost components are filled in and itemised, including exit and migration costs, with no hidden fees for API use, full downloads or test environments.
criteria.progress: The price schedule is complete but some components are bundled, conditional or unclear (for example volume-dependent fees or optional modules).
criteria.non-compliant: The price schedule is incomplete, or significant costs (exit, API, storage, modules) are missing or only available on request.

principles.improvementAction: Compare offers on total cost over the full potential term including extensions, not only the initial term.
